concept.promptSummary: Two-panel original-game-wolf side and front-three-quarter relaxed right-side collapse final pose; preserve appearance and proportions, firm muscles, supported body/head and relaxed paws, no rigid standing-pose roll.
concept.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a precise 3D animation pose reference sheet for MoonForest's existing alpha wolf. Image 1 is the exact existing game wolf identity and proportion reference: preserve its gray-violet coat, pale face and lower limbs, massive layered angular neck mane, stout muscular torso, long muzzle, large paws, tail and ALL limb segment lengths and thickness. Image 2 is an anatomical reference only for a wolf resting its cheek on the ground; do not copy that photograph's setting or coat. Primary request: show the game wolf after a natural collapse, completely relaxed on its RIGHT SIDE on a flat neutral gray floor, with its shoulder, ribcage side, hip, cheek and neck mane supported by the floor. TWO large panels: left clean full-body side view; right full-body front three-quarter view of THE SAME POSE. Head rests sideways on cheek with neck naturally curved and muzzle on floor, eyes closed. Four limbs rest asymmetrically and loosely: near foreleg naturally bent at elbow with paw lying forward on floor, far foreleg partly extended beneath/forward; near hind leg has anatomical hip, knee and hock bends with paw on floor, far hind leg rests a little behind. Paws must not stand supporting weight. Tail lies loosely along floor. Subtle natural spinal curve, preserve a firm intact ribcage and muscular thighs/forearms. This should read as a heavy quadruped that collapsed then went limp, not a standing pose rigidly rotated 90 degrees, not rigid toy legs pointing sideways, not sleeping with all legs neatly tucked under the chest. Orthographic-like production reference, clear joints and contact shadows, original stylized polygonal fur and original gray palette, soft studio light. No blood, no wounds, no text or arrows, no new armor, no exaggerated long or thin legs, no stretched rubber muscles, no broken limb angles, no extra legs. Entire wolf and tail visible in both panels.

findings: No gross elongated shafts or changing muscle core thickness in inspected frontal/lateral/oblique attack, brace, gait, death and distant orbit-to-run views.
Final collapse has asymmetrically relaxed paws, cheek and torso support, full tail in top/support views; no hidden floor penetration in final evaluated source proof.
Distant observation-to-run transition uses reachable fixed-length legs and releases unreachable earlier foot anchors. This does not certify every transient foot is stationary.
Existing hard/angular collar folds remain around bending joints. Rigid muscle cores and narrow transition bands are separate checks.
Source image concepts were generated before collapse authoring. Original R8 bone lengths and source weights remain authoritative.
limits: Real-device FPS, heat, GPU timings, touch feel and visible player knockdown animation were not measured.
